description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 3.x with Java 21 and Spring Framework 6.x, including Jakarta EE namespace migration and Dockerfile base image update
tasks.reason: The assessment flagged spring-boot-to-azure-spring-boot-version-01000 (Spring Boot 2.7.18 End of OSS Support), spring-framework-version-01000 (Spring Framework 5.x End of OSS Support), and azure-java-version-02000 (Java 8 legacy version). Upgrading to Spring Boot 3.x automatically includes Java 21 and Spring Framework 6.x, and is required for Azure compatibility.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the Spring Boot parent version from 2.7.18 to the latest Spring Boot 3.x stable release. Upgrade Java source and target from 8 to 21. Migrate all javax.* imports to jakarta.* throughout the codebase. Update the Dockerfile from maven:3.8-openjdk-8 and tomcat:8.5-jdk8 base images to Java 21 equivalents. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with the upgraded versions. The project must compile and all tests must pass after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Fix cloud readiness issues: replace hardcoded HTTP backend URL with environment-variable-driven configuration and remove insecure HTTP references
tasks.reason: AppCAT assessment flagged unsecure-network-protocol-00000 (HTTP usage in application.yml line 18 and SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java line 25), localhost-http-00001 (localhost HTTP call in SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java line 25), and hardcoded-urls-00001 (hardcoded URLs in application.yml and SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java). These issues prevent a clean, portable Azure deployment.
tasks.requirements: Replace the hardcoded backend.api.url value (http://backend:8080/api) in application.yml with an environment-variable placeholder so it can be overridden at runtime in Azure. Remove or update the System.out.println reference to http://localhost:8081 in SupplyChainFrontendApplication.java. Ensure the backend URL configuration supports HTTPS for secure cloud communication. No hardcoded hostnames or insecure HTTP scheme references should remain in source code or configuration files.

tasks.description: Validate and fix known CVE vulnerabilities in all project dependencies
tasks.reason: User explicitly requested all CVE issues be fixed. The project uses Spring Boot 2.7.18 and Java 8 which carry known CVE exposure in their dependency trees. After the framework upgrade, residual CVEs in transitive dependencies must be identified and remediated.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities using the GitHub Security Advisories API or equivalent tooling. Upgrade any dependency with a critical or high-severity CVE to a patched version. Ensure no critical or high-severity CVE issues remain in the dependency tree after remediation. The project must still compile and all tests must pass after dependency updates.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Java 21 runtime and Maven build tool established by task 001-upgrade-spring-boot-3.
